For Black Friday, Amazon is offering the well-reviewed GOOLOO A5 4,000A Cordless Jump Starter with Air Compressor for just $66.47 with free shipping after you apply coupon code " 0QUQM446 ". This is a combination 4,000A car jump starter, tire inflator, and 20,000mAh 45W power bank in one.

Black Friday Deal: GOOLOO 4,000A Jump Starter and Tire Inflator

The Gooloo A5 is first and foremost a 12V cordless car jump starter that can supply 4,000A of peak power. It can jump start up to any gas engine or up to 10L diesel engines and has a boost button in case you need extra power to start up a completely dead battery. Cordless jump starters essentially make traditional jumper cables obsolete, since you no longer need the assistance from someone else's car.

Second is the 160PSI (45lpm) air compressor, whose main function is as a tire inflator. It takes about two minute minutes to inflate a 285/70 R17 pickup truck tire from 30 PSI to 36 PSI and just 30 seconds to inflate a 195/65 R15 sedan tire. If you're using it to fix a flat, make sure you also have a tire patch kit to seal the hole afterwards. Like most tire inflators, this model can also be used to inflate other things like bicycle tires, balls, inflatables, and more.

Third, the GOOLOO A5 is equipped with a robust 20,000mAh USB-C power bank can be used to charge up your dead iPhone when you need it the most. Uncommon in jump starters, the power bank supports 45W of Power Delivery.
